name: EASYxSHOT
source:
A human born in space will only ever be human until they aren't, as is decided by those who are born of Earth. Of course such a notion would be rejected.

This is barely the start of it. Space is only beginning to be humanity's next battlefield.

A recruit of the Dandelion rebels made spur-of-the-moment sniper fighting for what she thinks is freedom, and a trained sniper for the Earth Protection Coalition who can't just let her go. Two girls who can't decide if they're fighting out of love or malice, their pasts set to alter their futures.

This can't be anything other than messy.
[From [url=https://killjill.itch.io/easyxshot]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
出生在太空中的人类只能成为人类，直到他们不再是人类，这是由地球上出生的人决定的。当然，这样的想法会被拒绝。

这仅仅是它的开始。太空才刚刚开始成为人类的下一个战场。

蒲公英叛军的一名新兵一时冲动成为了狙击手，为她认为的自由而战，而地球保护联盟的一名训练有素的狙击手却不能就这样放她走。两个女孩无法决定她们是出于爱还是出于恶意而战斗，她们的过去将改变她们的未来。

这只能是混乱。
[来自[url=https://killjill.itch.io/easyxshot]itch.io[/url]]
